en-US.title: RTSH TANI
en-US.subtitle: Live TV & radio from Albania
en-US.description:
RTSH TANI brings Albania's public broadcaster to your phone and tablet. Watch RTSH television channels live, listen to RTSH radio stations, and catch up on the programmes you missed.

LIVE TELEVISION
Stream RTSH channels live in adaptive quality that adjusts to your connection. Choose the quality yourself whenever you want, or let the app handle it.

RADIO THAT KEEPS PLAYING
RTSH radio stations with full background playback and lock-screen controls. Lock your phone or switch apps — the audio keeps going.

FULL TV GUIDE
Browse the complete schedule for every channel, seven days back and seven days ahead. Open any programme to read its description.

CATCH-UP
Missed something? Play it back straight from the guide. Pause, rewind and scrub through any recorded programme.

BUILT FOR EVERY SCREEN
Designed for iPhone and iPad, with picture-in-picture so you can keep watching while you do something else.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Albanian by default, with English available. Light and dark themes.

PARENTAL CONTROLS
Set a PIN on this device to gate age-restricted programming.

RTSH TANI is the official application of Radio Televizioni Shqiptar. An account is required. Some content may not be available in all regions.
en-US.promoText: Watch RTSH live — television and radio from Albania's public broadcaster. Full TV guide, catch up on the last seven days, and radio that keeps playing in the background.

review.notes:
RTSH TANI is the official OTT application of Radio Televizioni Shqiptar (RTSH), Albania's national public broadcaster. It streams RTSH's own live TV and radio channels plus catch-up of previously aired programming. The app's interface defaults to Albanian because the audience is Albanian; English is selectable in-app under Settings — Language.

CONTENT AVAILABILITY: all channels are currently available worldwide with no regional restriction, so every channel and every catch-up programme is playable from your location. The app does contain regional-availability handling because RTSH's broadcast rights are territorial and may change; if a channel ever becomes restricted, the app shows an explanatory notice rather than failing. Nothing is restricted at the time of this submission.

HOW TO REVIEW:
1. Sign in with the credentials above.
2. Home tab — tap any channel tile to start live playback. Use the Radio toggle to switch to radio stations.
3. Guide tab — the full 7-day programme schedule. Tap a past programme to play it back (catch-up).
4. Player — tap the screen for controls. The options sheet has quality selection and audio tracks.
5. Radio continues playing in the background and on the lock screen; this is intentional and is the app's core radio feature.

FEATURES THAT MAY PROMPT QUESTIONS:
- Cellular data gate: Settings has a "play over cellular" toggle. When off, a confirmation modal appears before playback starts on a cellular connection. Tap Continue to proceed.
- Parental control: Settings — Parental control sets a device-level PIN that gates age-restricted programmes. It is stored only on the device and never sent to our servers. It is off by default. This is the in-app control declared in the age-rating questionnaire.
- Advertising: short pre-roll and mid-roll ads may appear. These are RTSH's own promotional spots served from our backend; no third-party ad SDK is used. This is why the age-rating questionnaire declares advertising.
- Account deletion is available in-app: Profile — Delete account.
